# Inkwell

> Inkwell is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app (macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel). Type a trigger such as ?fix at the end of text in any app and Inkwell replaces it with the AI result in place. No account, no subscription and no Inkwell server.

## What it does
- ?fix fixes spelling, grammar and punctuation
- ?rewrite rewrites text so it reads more clearly
- ?formal rewrites in a polite, professional tone
- ?short makes text shorter
- ?ask answers the question in the text
- ?reply drafts a reply below a received message
- ?en translates to English
- Triggers are editable templates; users can add their own.

## Providers
- Gemini and Groq: free API keys. Multiple keys and fallback models are rotated automatically on rate limits.
- Claude Code and Codex: use the user's existing Claude or ChatGPT plan through the signed-in CLI.

## Privacy
- Only the last 64 typed characters are held in memory to detect triggers; nothing is logged.
- Text is sent only to the chosen provider, only when a trigger is typed.
- API keys are stored in the macOS Keychain. Password fields are never read.

## Install
- Homebrew: brew install --cask devrahulbanjara/inkwell/inkwell
- DMG: https://github.com/devrahulbanjara/inkwell/releases/latest/download/Inkwell.dmg
